name: Animated 3D Gaussian Splatting (Splatv rendering)
definition: A GPU-accelerated rendering method for time-varying 3D Gaussian splats. It computes time-dependent position, rotation, and scale deltas from packed texture data, projects them to screen space, computes the 2D covariance matrix, and renders each splat as a Gaussian quad with time-decayed opacity.
summary: Animated 3D Gaussian Splatting is a GPU-accelerated method that renders time-varying splats by computing motion deltas from packed textures, enabling smooth animation without per-frame CPU updates.
